Repo: /Users/tr/prog/silicon-photonics — "SiPhon", a silicon photonics toolkit (Python 3.13, numpy/scipy, src/siphon/, tests/, examples/). Run code freely with: cd /Users/tr/prog/silicon-photonics && uv run python ... . The full test suite (uv run pytest -q) currently passes 144 tests. Report ONLY defects that matter: wrong physics, wrong math, numerical fragility a user would plausibly hit, silently misleading APIs, or tests that would pass with broken physics. Do NOT report style, docstring nits, hypothetical micro-optimizations, or missing features. For every claim, compute a concrete counter-example or cite the standard formula you checked against. Quality over quantity — an empty findings list is a valid result.
You are refuter #2. A reviewer claims the following defect in SiPhon. Independently verify by reading the code and RUNNING it. Refute it if: the claim is factually wrong, the behavior is actually correct physics, the docstring already covers it as a documented limitation AND it would not mislead a competent user, or it is trivia not worth changing. Default to refuted=true if you cannot reproduce the problem concretely.

FINDING:
{
  "title": "energy_per_bit_pj laser_shared_by divides laser wall-plug energy by N while each lane still receives full per-line power",
  "file": "/Users/tr/prog/silicon-photonics/src/siphon/link.py",
  "line": 474,
  "severity": "major",
  "claim": "With laser_shared_by = N, the function models ceil(n_lanes/N) lasers each emitting only link.laser.power_dbm, while the LinkBudget simultaneously assumes every lane sees the full laser.power_dbm at the launch reference plane; a source feeding N lanes (split CW or N-line comb) must emit >= N x the per-line power, so laser energy per bit is silently underestimated by a factor of ~N.",
  "evidence": "Counter-example (preset_cpo_optical_io, 6.5 dBm/line, wpe=0.10, 8 lanes, laser_shared_by=8): code returns laser = 0.174 pJ/bit, modeling the shared source at dbm_to_mw(6.5)/0.10 = 44.7 mW electrical; physically the source must supply 8 lines x 4.47 mW optical = 357 mW electrical, i.e. 1.40 pJ/bit — an 8x underestimate. Sharing a source amortizes control/TEC overhead, not the raw optical power per line; energy conservation forbids delivering power_dbm to N lanes from one power_dbm emitter. Note tests/test_link.py:211 asserts e_shared['laser'] == e['laser']/4, locking in the unphysical behavior — the test passes with broken physics.",
  "suggested_fix": "Make the shared source emit laser_shared_by x the per-line power: laser_mw = n_lasers * laser_shared_by_effective_lines * dbm_to_mw(power_dbm) / wpe (equivalently just n_lanes * dbm_to_mw(power_dbm) / wpe), and let laser_shared_by amortize only a separate fixed per-device overhead term (or a wpe improvement). Fix tests/test_link.py:210-211 accordingly. If the current semantics ('power_dbm is the whole source, lanes tap a split of it') is intended instead, the LinkBudget launch power and this function must use consistent definitions and the split loss must appear in the path."
}

447	def energy_per_bit_pj(
448	    link: LinkBudget,
449	    n_lanes: int,
450	    laser_shared_by: int = 1,
451	    thermal_tuning_mw_per_lane: float = 0.0,
452	    serdes_pj_per_bit: float = 4.0,
453	) -> dict[str, float]:
454	    """Electrical energy per transported bit, pJ/bit, by contributor.
455	
456	    Returns {"laser", "modulator", "tia", "tuning", "serdes", "total"},
457	    all in pJ/bit averaged over the aggregate bit rate of ``n_lanes``
458	    identical lanes (1 mW / 1 Gb/s = 1 pJ/bit).
459	
460	    * laser: one line per lane; ceil(n_lanes / laser_shared_by) lasers
461	      each emitting link.laser.power_dbm optically, converted to
462	      electrical via wall-plug efficiency (electrical = optical / wpe).
463	      ``laser_shared_by`` amortizes a shared source (split or comb line).
464	    * modulator / tia: the components' energy_fj_per_bit.
465	    * tuning: per-lane thermal tuning power (ring heaters etc.), mW.
466	    * serdes: host-side serdes/DSP allocation, pJ/bit (dominant in
467	      pluggables with full DSP; small for XSR-class CPO die-to-optics).
468	    """
469	    if n_lanes < 1 or laser_shared_by < 1:
470	        raise ValueError("n_lanes and laser_shared_by must be >= 1")
471	    lane_gbps = link.signaling.bit_rate_gbps
472	    total_gbps = n_lanes * lane_gbps
473	    n_lasers = math.ceil(n_lanes / laser_shared_by)
474	    laser_mw = n_lasers * dbm_to_mw(link.laser.power_dbm) / link.laser.wpe
475	    out = {
476	        "laser": laser_mw / total_gbps,
477	        "modulator": link.modulator.energy_fj_per_bit * 1e-3,
478	        "tia": link.tia.energy_fj_per_bit * 1e-3,
479	        "tuning": thermal_tuning_mw_per_lane / lane_gbps,
480	        "serdes": serdes_pj_per_bit,
481	    }
482	    out["total"] = sum(out.values())
483	    return out
484
